title: The Lot Behind the Car Dealer
content: It's late afternoon and the sun is setting behind the car dealership in Kingston. I'm struck by a view that looks back to the lot where they keep all the extra cars.As complex as this scene first appears, it boils down to two simple flanking dark masses and a path of light back to the horizon.Darn! A big truck parks right in front of my view, so I have to deploy X-ray vision.
